tool.name: CpG Harmonisation Stage 4: Restriction to Common Probes
tool.description: Restricts to the 450K and EPIC shared probe set for downstream DMR/DMP analysis

configfiles.configfile:
require('minfi', quietly = TRUE) require('IlluminaHumanMethylation450kmanifest', quietly = TRUE) require('IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICmanifest', quietly = TRUE) options(warn = -1)
load('$grset_in') if (!exists('GRSet')) { stop("grset_in .rda must contain an object named 'GRSet'") }
probes450k <- getManifestInfo(IlluminaHumanMethylation450kmanifest, 'locusNames') probesEPIC <- getManifestInfo(IlluminaHumanMethylationEPICmanifest, 'locusNames') common.probes <- intersect(probes450k, probesEPIC) #450K ∩ EPIC shared probe set
GRSet.common <- GRSet[rownames(GRSet) %in% common.probes, ]
beta.common <- getBeta(GRSet.common) write.table(beta.common, file = '$beta_out', quote = FALSE, sep = '\t', col.names = NA)
summary.df <- data.frame( stage = c('input_probes', 'common_probes_450k_epic', 'retained'), count = c(nrow(GRSet), length(common.probes), nrow(GRSet.common)) ) write.table(summary.df, file = '$summarytab', quote = FALSE, sep = '\t', row.names = FALSE)
GRSet <- GRSet.common #keep the canonical 'GRSet' name for save(); GRSet.common is also written so minfi_analysis.xml's external_grset mode can consume this file directly save(GRSet, GRSet.common, file = '$grset_out')

param.name: grset_in
param.label: Stage 3 GenomicRatioSet
param.help: Must contain an object named GRSet - the Stage 3 (ComBat batch correction) output.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Stage 4 (final stage) of the cross-array (450K/EPIC) harmonisation pipeline. Takes the batch-corrected ``GenomicRatioSet`` from Stage 3 and restricts it to the probe set shared by the 450K and EPIC manifests, so that downstream analyses treat every sample consistently regardless of which array it was run on.
The output ``.rda`` contains an object named ``GRSet`` (and an identical alias ``GRSet.common``), matching the ``external_grset`` input mode of the existing ``minfi_analysis`` tool, so this pipeline's output can be fed directly into DMR/DMP hunting without re-running that tool's internal preprocessing.
***Inputs***
*Stage 3 GenomicRatioSet*: ``.rda`` output of the ComBat batch correction stage.
***Outputs***
*Stage 4 GenomicRatioSet*: an ``.rda`` file containing the common-probe-restricted ``GRSet``, ready for use as the ``minfi_analysis`` tool's pre-built GenomicRatioSet input.
*Harmonised Beta Matrix*: the common-probe beta values as a tab-separated matrix.
*Probe Retention Summary*: a small table reporting the input probe count, the size of the 450K/EPIC common probe set, and the number of probes retained.
